cases: 19 lyric cases (7 complete English mixes + 12 GTSinger clips); 7 non-lyric cases inherited with verified hashes
controls: Recompute small and turbo after explicitly seeding CTranslate2. Historical v2 predictions remain archived; alignment-only comparisons inherit identical recognition text.
reference_access: Audio and language metadata only for recognition. Gold reference lyrics are never passed to recognition, correction or alignment. User-supplied text is a separate product feature, never an ASR score.
input_ablation: Source mix versus separated vocals on the same 7 mixtures. These recognition runs recompute all 19 lyric cases; GTSinger input waveforms are identical. Alignment-only runs inherit measured ASR text and verify that normalized tokens stay unchanged.
performance: GPU inference serial; model download excluded. Report actual worker runtime packages, pinned model revisions, weight SHA-256 and allocator/device VRAM scopes.
promotion: All paired cases accounted for; no hidden failure retries. Choose the lyric text model by language/dataset errors, report time tradeoffs and regressions separately, and preserve baseline choices.
training_overlap: Training membership of Qwen/Heart checkpoints is not fully disclosed; this suite is an engineering regression, not a verified unseen-test leaderboard.
limits: Only seven English mixes, 64 Chinese characters and 55 English isolated-singing words. No labelled full Mandarin mixture; do not promise general song accuracy from these scores.
